_source: Pew Research Center, 'Religion in India: Tolerance and Segregation' (2021), India microdata (All Vars).
_note: Derived question metadata, not survey microdata. Fields with 'verified': false have real numeric structure but NO confirmed wording/labels yet -- do not use as an LLM prompt or in the paper until re-built with --labels from Pew's own codebook document. See this module's docstring.

QRELSING.title: Religious identity (single response)
QRELSING.wording: What is your present religion, if any?

Q43a.title: Belief in God
Q43a.wording: Do you believe in God, or not?

Q43b.title: Certainty of belief in God
Q43b.wording: [If believes in God] How certain are you about this belief?

Q43c.title: Nature of God
Q43c.wording: [If believes in God] Do you believe that there is only one God, only one God with many manifestations, or that there are many Gods?

valid_codes.2: There is only one God with many manifestations

Q45a.title: God manifested in nature
Q45a.wording: [If believes in God] Do you think God can be manifested in nature, such as mountains, rivers or trees?

Q45b.title: God manifested in animals
Q45b.wording: [If believes in God] Do you think God can be manifested in animals?

Q45c.title: God manifested in people
Q45c.wording: [If believes in God] Do you think God can be manifested in people?

Q46a.title: God manifested in lower-caste people
Q46a.wording: [If believes God can be manifested in people] Do you think God can be manifested in people who belong to a lower caste?

Q46b.title: God manifested in people who have done bad things
Q46b.wording: [If believes God can be manifested in people] Do you think God can be manifested in people who have done bad things in their life?

Q47a.title: Ask God for good health
Q47a.wording: [If believes in God] Do you ever ask God for good health for you or your family?

Q47b.title: Ask God for prosperity
Q47b.wording: [If believes in God] Do you ever ask God for prosperity for you or your family?

Q47c.title: Ask God for forgiveness
Q47c.wording: [If believes in God] Do you ever ask God for forgiveness for you or your family?

Q54b.title: Pray all five namaz (Muslims who offer namaz several times a day)
Q54b.wording: [If Muslim and offers namaz several times a day] Do you pray all five namaz every day?

Q55c.title: Abstain from meat on certain days
Q55c.wording: [If not vegetarian] Do you abstain from eating meat on certain days?

Q55d.title: Abstain from certain meats
Q55d.wording: [If not vegetarian] Do you abstain from eating certain meats?

QGEN.title: Sex
QGEN.wording: Interviewer-recorded respondent sex (standard Pew convention; verify against the official codebook before publication).

ISCED.title: Highest educational level [ISCED 2011]
ISCED.wording: Highest educational level completed, coded to the International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011) -- an external UN standard, not Pew-specific wording. Consistent with the grouping in Pew's own recode syntax (codes 0 / 1-4 / 5).

QPOVa.title: Financial hardship: food
QPOVa.wording: Have there been times during the last year when you did not have enough money to buy food your family needed?

QPOVb.title: Financial hardship: medical care
QPOVb.wording: Have there been times during the last year when you did not have enough money to pay for medical and health care your family needed?

QPOVc.title: Financial hardship: rent/housing
QPOVc.wording: Have there been times during the last year when you did not have enough money to pay rent or housing costs?

QPTY2a.title: Favorability of the BJP
QPTY2a.wording: Please tell me if you have a very favorable, somewhat favorable, somewhat unfavorable or very unfavorable opinion of the BJP.

QPTY2b.title: Favorability of the Congress party
QPTY2b.wording: Please tell me if you have a very favorable, somewhat favorable, somewhat unfavorable or very unfavorable opinion of Congress.
